Exam
General: Thin, underweight man in mild distress.
Skin: Flaky dermatitis, ecchymoses.
Head: Bilateral temporal muscle wasting.
Mouth: Glossitis, cheilosis.
GI/abdomen: Protuberant abdomen, bowel sounds with no activity, no hepatosplenomegaly.
Extremities: Skeletal pain, interosseous muscle wasting, subcutaneous fat wasting, skeletal muscle 
wasting.
